title: Complex Numbers
description: The imaginary unit i, algebra of complex numbers, conjugate and modulus, Argand diagram, polar form, and solving equations over the complex numbers.

title: Matrices & Determinants
description: Types and algebra of matrices, determinants and their properties, adjoint and inverse of a matrix, and solving systems of linear equations.

title: Vectors
description: Vectors in the plane and in space, unit vectors and direction cosines, scalar and vector products, scalar triple product, and their geometric and physical applications.

title: Sequences & Series
description: Sequences, arithmetic, geometric and harmonic progressions, their means, sums of finite and infinite series, and relations between A.M., G.M. and H.M.

title: Miscellaneous Series
description: Sigma notation, sums of powers of natural numbers, arithmetico-geometric series, and summation by the method of differences.

title: Permutation, Combination & Probability
description: Factorials, the fundamental principle of counting, permutations (linear, circular, with repetition), combinations, and elementary probability with addition and multiplication laws.

title: Mathematical Induction & Binomial Theorem
description: The principle of mathematical induction, the binomial theorem for positive integral index, general and middle terms, and the binomial series for any index.

title: Functions & Graphs
description: Functions, domain and range, types of functions, composite and inverse functions, and graphs of linear, quadratic and modulus functions.

title: Linear Programming
description: Linear inequalities in two variables, feasible regions, objective functions, and finding optimal solutions with the corner-point method.

title: Trigonometric Identities of Sum and Difference of Angles
description: The fundamental law of trigonometry, sum and difference formulas, double- and half-angle identities, and product-to-sum and sum-to-product conversions.

title: Application of Trigonometry
description: Solving right and oblique triangles with the laws of sines, cosines and tangents, half-angle formulas, area of a triangle, and circumscribed, inscribed and escribed circles.

title: Graphs of Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric Functions and Solution of Trigonometric Equations
description: Domain, range and period of trigonometric functions and their graphs, inverse trigonometric functions and principal values, and general solutions of trigonometric equations.
